title: Automatic OpenAPI and deployment with Uvicorn and Docker
summary: FastAPI generates an OpenAPI schema from routes, type hints and models, and serves it at /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json.

sections.definition: FastAPI generates an OpenAPI schema from routes, type hints and models, and serves it at /docs (Swagger UI), /redoc and /openapi.json. In production it runs on Uvicorn, an ASGI server; fastapi run uses it under the hood. The official documentation packages it in Docker with the python:3.14 image.
sections.analogy: OpenAPI is the restaurant menu that reprints itself every time you change a recipe.
sections.problem: Hand-written documentation goes stale at the first change. In deployment, using dev mode or the shell form of CMD causes problems: unnecessary reloading and a shutdown that does not run the lifespan.
sections.code:example:
app = FastAPI(title="Tienda API", version="1.0.0")

@app.get(
    "/productos/{producto_id}",
    tags=["productos"],
    summary="Obtener un producto",
    responses={404: {"description": "El producto no existe"}},
)
def obtener(producto_id: int) -> ProductoPublico: ...

# Desarrollo: recarga automática, solo en 127.0.0.1
#   uv run fastapi dev app/main.py
# Producción: sin recarga, escucha en 0.0.0.0
#   fastapi run app/main.py --port 80
# Dockerfile (basado en la documentación oficial)
FROM python:3.14
WORKDIR /code
COPY ./requirements.txt /code/requirements.txt      # generado con uv export
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade -r /code/requirements.txt
COPY ./app /code/app
CMD ["fastapi", "run", "app/main.py", "--port", "80"]

# compose.yaml
services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports: ["8000:80"]
    env_file: .env          # DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://tienda:secreto@db:5432/tienda
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: tienda
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: secreto
      POSTGRES_DB: tienda
    volumes: ["pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data"]
volumes:
  pgdata:
sections.bad:
CMD fastapi dev app/main.py --host 0.0.0.0
# DATABASE_URL=...@localhost:5432/tienda

Dev mode in production, CMD in shell form (no clean shutdown) and localhost inside the container, which is the container itself.
sections.good:
CMD ["fastapi", "run", "app/main.py", "--port", "80"]
# DATABASE_URL=...@db:5432/tienda

Exec form and the Compose service name as host.
sections.bridge:typescript: fastapi dev vs fastapi run ≈ the development server (vite dev) vs serving the build. Uvicorn takes the place of Node's HTTP server. With /openapi.json you can generate the typed TypeScript client with openapi-generator and stop writing interfaces by hand.
sections.interview: FastAPI generates OpenAPI automatically from the type hints and the Pydantic models, so Swagger always reflects the code and I can generate typed clients. For production I use fastapi run, which runs Uvicorn without reloading, inside a Docker container with CMD in exec form for a clean shutdown. Configuration arrives through environment variables, and with Docker Compose I bring up the API alongside PostgreSQL using the service name as host.
sections.myths:
• Using localhost for the DB inside Docker Compose: use the service name.
  • Putting secrets in the image instead of environment variables.
  • Leaving /docs public on an internal API without thinking about it.
  • Several workers in one container when you already scale with replicas: the docs recommend one process per container in that case.

items.q: Inside Docker Compose, which host goes in DATABASE_URL to reach Postgres?
items.why: Compose creates a network where each service is resolved by its name.

items.q: What sets fastapi run apart from fastapi dev?
options: run is for production: no reloading and listens on 0.0.0.0
items.why: dev reloads on save and listens on 127.0.0.1; run is meant for production.
